en: Revenue of $46.7B (+41% in dollars) beat the top of guidance and EPS of $4.60 per ADR topped the ~$4.42 consensus. HPC grew 22% QoQ to 68% of sales and 2nm reached 8% of wafer revenue, while gross margin eased to 66.4% on the 2nm ramp. The Q4 guide of $52.3–54.3B is well above the ~$51.2B consensus, and 2026 growth rose to ~44%. C.C. Wei said AI demand is still far above supply but planning for 2027 is prudent as consumer markets weaken; capex stays $60–64B.

The ADR had already fallen 3.4% to $430 on Oct 14 in a global chip selloff, then gapped down to $415 on Oct 15 as Korean chip stocks crashed and Wei's cautious 2027 remark weighed, closing down 1.8% at $422.25. Over the following week it recovered to $431.89 by Oct 21 as chips rebounded, then fell 4.5% to $412.35 on Oct 22 when Meta's spending worries sent the chip index down 6.7%, leaving it 2.3% below the first-session close.
zh: 营收 467 亿美元（以美元计 +41%）高于指引上限，每份 ADR 收益 4.60 美元高于约 4.42 美元的一致预期。高性能计算环比增长 22%，占营收 68%；2 纳米占晶圆营收 8%，毛利率因 2 纳米爬坡降至 66.4%。第四季营收指引 523–543 亿美元，明显高于约 512 亿美元的市场预期，2026 年增长展望上调至约 44%。魏哲家表示 AI 需求仍远高于供应能力，但因消费类市场转弱，对 2027 年规划审慎；资本开支维持 600–640 亿美元。

在全球芯片股抛售中，ADR 于 10 月 14 日已下跌 3.4% 至 430 美元；10 月 15 日因韩国芯片股暴跌及魏哲家对 2027 年的审慎表态跳空低开至 415 美元，收跌 1.8% 至 422.25 美元。随后一周，随芯片股反弹，10 月 21 日回升至 431.89 美元；10 月 22 日 Meta 引发的支出担忧使费城半导体指数下跌 6.7%，ADR 下跌 4.5% 至 412.35 美元，较首个交易日收盘价低 2.3%。

bio.en: Yale PhD in electrical engineering who joined TSMC in 1998 from Chartered Semiconductor. Co-CEO from 2013, CEO since 2018 and chairman since 2024; steering the 2nm ramp and new fabs in Arizona, Japan and Germany.
bio.zh: 耶鲁大学电子工程博士，1998 年从特许半导体加入台积电。2013 年任共同执行长，2018 年起任总裁（CEO），2024 年起兼任董事长；主导 2 纳米量产及美国亚利桑那、日本、德国新厂建设。

bio.en: CFO and spokesperson since September 2019, after serving as deputy CFO. Joined TSMC in 1999 and led major deals such as the acquisitions of TASMC and WSMC; earlier corporate finance roles at ING Barings, Chase Manhattan and Bankers Trust.
bio.zh: 2019 年 9 月由副财务长升任财务长兼发言人。1999 年加入台积电，主导收购德碁半导体与世大积体电路等重大交易；更早任职于 ING 霸菱、大通银行和信孚银行的企业融资部门。
